skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the role of software testing in SDLC, processes and planning, and techniques in design and execution.
Apply black box testing methods and distinguish between different levels of testing such as unit, integration, and system testing.
Apply white box testing methods including control flow analysis and data flow analysis.
Understand and apply automated testing techniques using tools like NUnit and .NET Framework.
Manage the testing process from planning to completion, including reading and understanding test plans, exit criteria, and defect logs.
Collect, synthesize, analyze, and present information effectively to solve problems related to software testing.
Communicate effectively through writing reports, giving presentations, and collaborating online.
Apply knowledge, methods, techniques, and tools appropriately to develop and evaluate software in specific projects.
Develop the ability to learn independently and conduct research to complete assigned tasks.
Organize group activities, execute and evaluate the quality of work done by team members.
Understand the responsibilities and maintain professional ethics in software testing tasks.
